headline_marked: Houthis [[attack power station in Medina]] providing electricity to Prophet's Mosque
headline: Houthis attack power station in Medina providing electricity to Prophet's Mosque
summary: The Saudi-led coalition accuses Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis of using a drone to strike a civilian facility in one of Islam's holiest cities.
details: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis allegedly struck an electricity distribution station in the holy city of Medina, Saudi Arabia, according to the Saudi-led coalition.
The drone hit the Taibah electricity distribution station at 5:11 am on September 29, which provides power to the Prophet's Mosque.
Coalition spokesman Major General Turki al-Maliki stated that evidence and drone wreckage confirmed the involvement of the Houthi militia in the attack.
While one transformer was taken out of service, the coalition reported that the wider electricity network remained unaffected.
The Houthis have denied involvement in the attack, with a senior official rejecting accusations of targeting Islamic holy sites.
The attack sparked strong condemnation from Turkey, Qatar, the League of Arab States, and Al-Azhar, calling it a grave assault on the sanctity of Islamic holy sites.
Simultaneously, the internationally recognised government's military carried out strikes on Houthi targets in Sanaa, Saada, and Taiz as fighting intensifies in Yemen.
caption:
A drone strike on a power station supplying the Prophet's Mosque in Medina has sparked global outrage.

Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis allegedly struck an electricity distribution station in the holy city of Medina, Saudi Arabia, according to the Saudi-led coalition.

The drone hit the Taibah electricity distribution station at 5:11 am on September 29, which provides power to the Prophet's Mosque.

Coalition spokesman Major General Turki al-Maliki stated that evidence and drone wreckage confirmed the involvement of the Houthi militia in the attack.

While one transformer was taken out of service, the coalition reported that the wider electricity network remained unaffected.

The Houthis have denied involvement in the attack, with a senior official rejecting accusations of targeting Islamic holy sites.

The attack sparked strong condemnation from Turkey, Qatar, the League of Arab States, and Al-Azhar, calling it a grave assault on the sanctity of Islamic holy sites.

Simultaneously, the internationally recognised government's military carried out strikes on Houthi targets in Sanaa, Saada, and Taiz as fighting intensifies in Yemen.

headline_marked: US-made [[F-16V fighter jets arrive in Taiwan]] to counter China
headline: US-made F-16V fighter jets arrive in Taiwan to counter China
summary: The first two aircraft of a 66-jet order arrive at Taitung air base, strengthening Taiwan's air force against rising military threats from Beijing.
details: The first two of a batch of 66 new F-16V fighter jets ordered in 2019 will arrive in Taiwan on Friday. The delivery is destined for the Taitung air base on the island's mountainous east coast.
caption:
Taiwan receives its first new F-16V fighter jets after months of delays, strengthening its air defenses against China.

The first two of a batch of 66 new F-16V fighter jets ordered in 2019 will arrive in Taiwan on Friday. The delivery is destined for the Taitung air base on the island's mountainous east coast.
